description: Machine-contract fixture for signed Event scope_ref, projected object effective_scope, and Circle lifecycle admission. Producer supplies scope_circle_id where the payload owns it and signs the matching scope_ref; the reducer verifies that scope and may materialize effective_scope only in object read projections. Covers source-Station serializable admission ordering, archive and tombstone barriers, restore re-signing, Event expected_revision checks, rebind transitions, and negative cases. See spec/v1/zh/models/circle.md §6.1 / §6.2 / §7 / §9.2 / §10.2.

submit_payload_shape.description: Generic actor-supplied scope fragment for object payload schemas that own scope_circle_id (for example Strand, Morph, Relation, and scoped Space creation/update). It MUST NOT carry effective_scope. Message and structural-operation payloads that derive scope from accepted target references do not embed this fragment; they still sign Event.scope_ref.

canonical_reducer_output_shape.description: Reducer-derived, immutable tagged effective_scope written only to the materialized object typed current result, never to the Event Envelope. Two discriminated forms: kind=realm | kind=circle.

scope_rebind_transition_cases.name: none_to_none_noop
scope_rebind_transition_cases.description: scope_circle_id=null -> scope_circle_id=null. No-op rebind; reducer MUST accept when the signed scope_ref remains {kind:realm}; the object projection effective_scope remains Realm-scoped.

scope_rebind_transition_cases.name: same_circle_to_same_circle_noop
scope_rebind_transition_cases.description: scope_circle_id=Some(A) -> scope_circle_id=Some(A). No-op rebind; reducer MUST accept.

scope_rebind_transition_cases.name: none_to_circle_default_reject
scope_rebind_transition_cases.description: scope_circle_id=null -> scope_circle_id=Some(A). True rebind; default reducer MUST reject with failed_precondition reason=scope_rebind_forbidden. Profile MAY enable audit-paired high-risk update.

scope_rebind_transition_cases.name: circle_to_none_default_reject
scope_rebind_transition_cases.description: scope_circle_id=Some(A) -> scope_circle_id=null. True rebind; default reducer MUST reject with failed_precondition reason=scope_rebind_forbidden. Profile MAY enable audit-paired high-risk update.

scope_rebind_transition_cases.name: circle_a_to_circle_b_default_reject
scope_rebind_transition_cases.description: scope_circle_id=Some(A) -> scope_circle_id=Some(B). True rebind across circles; default reducer MUST reject with failed_precondition reason=scope_rebind_forbidden. Profile MAY enable audit-paired high-risk update.

negative_cases.name: submit_payload_carrying_effective_scope_rejected
negative_cases.description: Actor MUST NOT supply effective_scope in submit payload. Reducer MUST schema_violation with reason=effective_scope_reducer_managed.

negative_cases.name: relation_create_payload_carrying_effective_scope_rejected
negative_cases.description: ak.relation.create whose payload.relation carries effective_scope or any other materialized Relation member MUST be rejected with schema_violation and MUST NOT produce any projection write. The decision is schema-level and needs no projection pre-state: event-payload.schema.json#/$defs/relation_create_object resolves to the closed six-field relation_definition authoring region, while the reducer alone derives and maintains materialized members.

negative_cases.name: relation_create_top_level_rank_rejected
negative_cases.description: The former top-level payload.rank is not a Relation create input. relation.rank inside the closed relation_definition is the only signed rank carrier and the only rank consumed by the create projection; accepting both would create two signed truths for one value.

negative_cases.name: relation_update_patch_carrying_effective_scope_rejected
negative_cases.description: ak.relation.update whose payload.patch addresses effective_scope, or any effective_scope.* descendant, MUST be rejected with schema_violation reason=effective_scope_reducer_managed and MUST NOT produce any projection write. Patch atomicity applies: the whole map fails closed, so no sibling path in the same patch is applied. The forbidden set is registered per object kind in registry/reducer-managed-path-registry.json and, for Relation, is additionally enforced by the propertyNames guard on event-payload.schema.json#/$defs/relation_update_payload; implementations MUST read it from the registry rather than hard-coding a parallel list.

patch.fields.assignment_note: sibling path in the same patch, MUST NOT be applied

negative_cases.name: relation_update_primary_domain_identity_patch_rejected
negative_cases.description: relation_kind/from_ref/to_ref define the primary_conflict_domain and are create-locked. ak.relation.update MUST reject a patch touching any of them; changing domain is an explicit tombstone followed by create, never a cross-domain move.

negative_cases.name: scope_circle_id_targets_inactive_circle
negative_cases.description: scope_circle_id references a Circle with state != active. Reducer MUST failed_precondition reason=circle_not_active.

negative_cases.name: scope_circle_id_realm_mismatch
negative_cases.description: scope_circle_id references a Circle whose realm_id != object.realm_id. Reducer MUST schema_violation reason=circle_realm_mismatch.

negative_cases.name: event_missing_scope_ref_rejected_at_schema
negative_cases.description: Every Event, including an ak.message.create derived from a Circle-scoped Strand, MUST carry signed scope_ref before reducer admission. Schema validation rejects a missing scope_ref; no receiver may accept first and later add or infer a wire field.

negative_cases.name: scope_ref_mismatches_scope_circle_id
negative_cases.description: The signed Event scope_ref MUST equal the scope derived from the target object's accepted projection: scope_circle_id=null -> {kind:realm}; scope_circle_id=C -> {kind:circle, circle_id:C}. Receiver MUST reject a mismatch and MUST NOT rewrite the signed field. A separately materialized object effective_scope is projection output and must copy the verified scope_ref.

negative_cases.name: signed_scope_ref_tamper
negative_cases.description: scope_ref is producer-signed and bound by Event identity. Scope mutation invalidates the proof; ordinary data needs no extra pre-existing security checkpoint, but acceptance still requires its own covering RealmCommit.

negative_cases.name: content_plaintext_after_mls_activation
negative_cases.description: A scope whose ak.mls.genesis is accepted requires the verified Event scope_ref for every Strand/Message/Morph/Blob content write to carry RFC 9420 application ciphertext. An ak.message.create carrying plaintext content into that activated scope MUST be rejected with failed_precondition reason=mls_activation_required.
